subject: Business Models
title: Tokenized Real Estate
description: A fast breakdown of Tokenized Real Estate for builders.

hook.text: You can now buy $50 of a Manhattan apartment building. Tokenization splits real estate into digital shares.

buildup.text: Blockchain tokens represent fractional ownership of real assets: buildings, art, and even farmland.

discovery.text: Tokenization makes illiquid assets liquid. Instead of selling an entire building, you sell thousands of tiny shares.

twist.text: Regulatory uncertainty slows adoption. Are tokens securities? Different countries give different answers.

climax.text: If tokenization scales, millions of people could own pieces of assets previously reserved for the ultra-wealthy.

punchline.text: $50 for a slice of Manhattan. Tokenization democratizes real estate ownership.

quiz.question: What does tokenized real estate enable?
options: Fractional ownership of properties through digital tokens
